scope: Read-only research for all 531 observed instruction elements; not a production mapping source

source.dataLicense: not separately established; mapping file has no independent license notice
source.programLicense: LeoCAD README and COPYING state GPLv2; this is not asserted as an independent data license

fieldSemanticsEvidence.observation: lcLoadLDrawXML reads Brick.lego into a design-ID map; lcImportLXFMLFile queries that map using Part.designID. Its numeric filename fallback was intentionally not adopted.

limitations: Distinct Element IDs, Design IDs and LDraw filenames are different counting units.
Multiple Brick entries can represent old/new molds, aliases or import/export alternatives; this research does not resolve such identity differences.
A local library containing only one of several source targets cannot establish that target as the correct variant.
Source licensing and mapping semantics need review before integration; this research does not request approval or change current admission.
No XML source file or GPL program code is bundled in this artifact.
